$comment: Cover-sheet spec for Wear Compose Material 3. The component inventory — ids, grouping, captions, and per-variant tags — now lives next to the `@Preview`s as `@CatalogComponent` / `@CatalogVariant` annotations (see CatalogPreviews.kt); the design-artifacts export builds the catalog from those. This file carries only the fields that aren't per-component code metadata: the system slug, title, the library covered, the primary modes (Wear is dark-first, so `modes` is the single dark capture via `@CatalogWearModes`), the round-size breakpoints the full-screen components fan out across via `@CatalogWearBreakpoints`, the `display` stage/hero hints, the `groupOrder` (the group/tab display order — presentation config the annotation-derived source order can't express), and the published-kit references seeded for the one-off import (our render stays authoritative). State variants that differ only by a `previewOverride*` knob ride the primary function via `@OverrideVariant`.
title: Wear Compose Material 3
